pageDescription: Securely store credentials used by integrations, adapters and external services.
encryptedSecretsDescription: Values are encrypted at rest and only decrypted when authorized services request them.
emptyDescription: Store API tokens, signing secrets and credentials that Kurrier integrations can use securely.
footerNote: Secret values are encrypted before storage. Integrations can reference Vault entries without storing credentials in their own configuration.
keyHelp: A stable name applications and adapters can reference.
